description: The file defines the CartViewModel class, a ViewModel for managing shopping cart state in an Android app. It interacts with a CartRepository to persist data and exposes methods for cart operations such as add, remove, increase/decrease quantity, calculate total, and clear cart.

classes.name: CartViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that manages shopping cart state, communicates with CartRepository for persistence, and provides methods to modify and access cart data.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart and updates the cart LiveData.

methods.name: increaseQty
methods.description: Increases the quantity of a product in the cart by product ID.

methods.name: decreaseQty
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of a product in the cart by product ID.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by product ID.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price of items in the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and reloads the cart state.
